reboot.story.path.vengeance.name: Vengeance
reboot.story.path.vengeance.summary: Buy back everything your old landlord owns, put him out on the street, hire the best lawyers and win back custody of your son. It takes money and low suspicion: no lawyer takes a client who is too exposed.
reboot.story.path.resilience.name: Resilience
reboot.story.path.resilience.summary: Pay back what you stole, build schools and hospitals, fund wells, and keep only enough to live on. You have to succeed first to be able to give it up.
reboot.story.path.madness.name: Madness
reboot.story.path.madness.summary: Go after the biggest company, then whole countries, until the war that ends the world. It takes bots and wins, and the heat never comes back down.
reboot.story.project.vengeance.1: Buy back the old landlord's properties
reboot.story.project.vengeance.3: Win back custody of your son
reboot.story.choose.title: Choose your path
reboot.story.choose.copy: You have the means to change things. Three ways to do it, one per run. Each path has three projects to finish in P5.
reboot.story.choose.confirm: Choose "{path}"? This choice is permanent for this run.

reboot.story.ending.vengeance.label: Vengeance
reboot.story.ending.vengeance.title: Everything they took
reboot.story.ending.vengeance.p1: The old landlord sleeps on the street he promised you. His buildings carry your name, and he knows it.
reboot.story.ending.vengeance.p2: The lawyers did their job. One morning, the judge gives you custody of your son.
reboot.story.ending.vengeance.p3: You ring the bell of your old apartment. He runs to you. You took everything back, except the lost time.
reboot.story.ending.resilience.label: Resilience
reboot.story.ending.resilience.title: Enough for the rent
reboot.story.ending.resilience.p1: You paid back what you could, down to the last transfer. Those who received the money will never know where it came from.
reboot.story.ending.resilience.p2: There are schools where there were none, a hospital that stays open at night, wells that run.
reboot.story.ending.resilience.p3: You have just enough left for the rent. You call your wife and ask for nothing. It's the first time in a long while you dial a number without fearing the answer.
reboot.story.ending.madness.label: Madness
reboot.story.ending.madness.title: Nothing left to switch off
reboot.story.ending.madness.p1: The biggest company in the world fell in one night. The countries followed, one by one.
reboot.story.ending.madness.p2: Your bots won't stop. You weren't steering them anymore anyway: they're doing what you built them to do.
reboot.story.ending.madness.p3: The lights go out region by region. You watch the map turn black, and you feel nothing.
reboot.story.ending.prison.label: Prison
reboot.story.ending.prison.title: The file was complete
reboot.story.ending.prison.p1: The agents are there before you've shut the computer down. No shouting, no kicked-in door: they had your address for weeks.
reboot.story.ending.prison.p2: The trial takes a morning. The bots, the money, everything is seized.
reboot.story.ending.prison.p3: There's no connection in the cell. Only time, and the image of the son you couldn't keep. You can start again: this time, watch your suspicion.
reboot.guide.step.story.title: Choosing a path
reboot.guide.step.story.body: In P4 you pick a path: Vengeance, Resilience or Madness. The choice is permanent. In P5 you carry out its three projects to reach an ending. Watch your suspicion: at 100%, a warrant is issued.
